notes.title: The store page for “Mercenaries Lament” is now open!
notes.content:
The long wait is over!
The official store page for “Mercenaries Lament: Requiem of the Silver Wolf”, the newest game of the Mercenaries series, is now open for viewing.
We hope you’ll consider adding it to your Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2321040/Mercenaries_Lament/


[h3]A prayer for the fallen to rise from the depths of despair—[/h3]

The characters are beautifully drawn with rich facial expressions by the illustrator Sakura Mochi!


[Story]
Several years have passed since a mysterious disease with no cure quickly spread across the continent.
Those infected would suffer a horrible fate of turning into zombies after their death, mindlessly attacking the living. It has become the norm for hired mercenaries to spend countless days clearing the lands of the undead.
Such a mercenary is Johann, captain of the Silver Wolf Mercenary Company. He is paid a visit by the Grim Reaper, and narrowly escapes its blade of death, but the Reaper leaves him with an eerie prophecy: "In the next 100 days, your luck shall run out. That shall be the day of your fate.”
After awaking from a delirious slumber, he is met by a young woman with miraculous powers that can heal people from the disease.
Was his encounter with the Grim Reaper but a nightmare....?
Regardless, Johann offers to protect the miracle worker on her travels to save as many people as she can. They set out on a journey to travel the kingdom, curing the infected.
Soon, however, Johann must confront his mortality…


ーーーーーーー

notes.title: 「Mercenaries Rebirth: Call of the Wild Lynx」Store Page Release！
notes.content:
Hello, everyone. It's Kou from FHW.

Today, we are proud to announce the release of the classic tactical simulation RPG[b]「Mercenaries Rebirth: Call of the Wild Lynx」[/b]'s STEAM Store Page.


[previewyoutube=Yx9YSS0lKow;full][/previewyoutube]


●STEAM【Mercenaries Rebirth Store Page】

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1867810/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1867810/[/url]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40609327/632446e9aac1fa71c444cc3a9f58814fbf8c78ea.jpg[/img]

[h3]Princess, with your Mercenaries, take up the sword and rise to victory！[/h3]

「Mercenaries Rebirth」is a [b]Tactical Simulation RPG[/b] set in a fantasy world. 

Battles occur on quarter-view maps with height differences, wherein the front, back, and side of the map determine each battle’s outcome. Support effects depend on where allied characters from your party are in position, etc., features of high strategic maneuvers.

 
Enjoy a high degree of character cultivation by using skill points earned in battles, skill acquisition, enhancements, class change, etc. 


Talented Illustrator [b]Makimura Shunsuke san[/b] is the appointed character designer! Beautifully drawn characters play more active roles with rich facial expressions that vary from joy, sadness, anger, etc.

[h3]Rebirth Exceed is the key to victory! [/h3]

The gauge in the upper right corner of the screen builds up anytime the Player attacks and defends during battles. 

Store enough power to activate a particular skill called [b]「Rebirth Exceed」[/b]!

Each character has unique talents, including dealing with godly damage to enemies and reviving fallen allies who cannot fight.

Rebirth Exceed is the key to victory!
